"},{"order":11,"type":"subheading","text":"Key ARIA Attributes to Remember"},{"order":12,"type":"bullet_point","text":"aria-expanded: Indicates whether a collapsible element is currently expanded or collapsed."},{"order":13,"type":"bullet_point","text":"aria-hidden: Hides decorative or redundant content from assistive technologies when set to "true"."},{"order":14,"type":"bullet_point","text":"aria-label: Defines a string value that labels an interactive element when no visible text is present."},{"order":15,"type":"bullet_point","text":"aria-labelledby: Identifies the element that labels the current component by referencing its ID."},{"order":16,"type":"subheading","text":"Conclusion"},{"order":17,"type":"paragraph","text":"While Bootstrap handles most heavy lifting for core components, developers must stay vigilant with custom implementations, semantic markup, and thorough screen reader testing to achieve full a11y compliance."}]
